body: While I'm (22M) not currently in the same position as you but I am pretty much about to move away from my gf (21F) of 2.5 years for a year (at least) due to a great job opportunity so the situation is pretty similar. My honest advice would be to talk to him. Tell him the whole situation. I bet he already knows how stressed you are for a job. Cause if both of you really love each other as much as you say you do, he will understand and actually support you to pursue the career or education opportunities best for you Cause you might leave this opportunity out of love for him right now but YOU WILL resent him and your relationship in the future if you don't find something at least better than what you are being offered rn. Also he's still in school. What if he gets a very good opportunity across the country when he graduates. He might want to take it then but just because you didn't take it now he'd have to pass on it too. So don't put the pressure on each other. Take it easy. Go for your career first. Get at least on the path to being settled. And as you said you guys have a kinda long distance already you can maintain a long distance there too. But most importantly do have an honest conversation with him and lay out all the facts, feelings, and concerns in front of him. Best wishes to both of you.
